commenti.body:
About 15 years ago I watched Thirteen and Kids back to back as a double feature. For some reason my sister, who isn't really a cinephile, had both movies. I think, when she was a teen, she went through an exploratory edgy phase that she eventually softened out of.

I enjoyed both movies. But I sort of put them in a box of "Great movies I'll never watch again."

It's also interesting that Kids was written by a young Harmony Korine and Thirteen was co-written by a young Nikki Reed. Another sort of similarity between the two.
